title: Session Bug Label
description: Post-hoc classification of a debugging session from MCP call logs. Each entry labels one 'debugging episode' — a contiguous sequence of tool calls focused on diagnosing and fixing a single bug.

session_id.description: MCP session ID from the call log (matches session field in NDJSON)

episode_id.description: Unique identifier for this debugging episode within the session (session may have multiple bugs)

start_seq.description: First call sequence number in this episode

end_seq.description: Last call sequence number in this episode

call_range.description: Range of call sequence numbers that belong to this debugging episode

bug_layer.description: Compilation layer where the root cause lives

bug_category.description: Category of the bug within its layer

condition.description: Whether --debug-layers was active during this episode

fix_commit.description: Git commit hash of the fix (if outcome=fixed)

total_calls.description: Total MCP tool calls in this episode

navigation_calls.description: Read + Grep + Glob calls (via other tools, not MCP)

time_to_fix_s.description: Wall clock seconds from first failure to passing test

metrics.description: Computed metrics for this episode (auto-filled by analysis script)
